workload: 400 calibration documents of 1600 whitespace tokens, packed into the function's 2048-token blocks
notes: Each row is tokenized with its own processor call, then ids are concatenated as Python lists and sliced into new lists before tensor conversion. One batched tokenizer call plus a single tensor pack yields the same blocks and removes that per-row loop. Open upstream PRs do not touch this file.

workload: One fp32 4096x8192 linear weight, the E2M1 cast used when packing NVFP4 weights
notes: Round-half-to-even expands a 7-element tie mask and compares every magnitude to all 7 E2M1 bounds, so the call holds a (*weight.shape, 7) bool tensor and a matching product. Equality against the three odd tie levels matches the uint4 codes and roughly halves sampled peak RSS on this weight. Called by nvfp4_quantize_pack, which the named tests exercise. Open upstream PRs do not touch this file.

workload: One fp32 4096x8192 linear weight, the E2M1 cast used by FOCUS MXFP4 export
notes: Separate copy of the E2M1 tie rule: torch.any over (magnitude.unsqueeze(-1) == bounds) materializes a 7-wide temporary per element. A three-level equality check matches codes, including the round-half-to-even ties the unit test locks, and lowers peak RSS. Open upstream PRs do not touch this file.

Each query block mean-pools and matmuls against every key inside a Python loop. One matmul over the block axis reproduces the bool mask and is several times faster at 1k-4k. The named test calls this function when CUDA is present; on this CPU host it skips and pytest exits 0. Not _scatter_diagonals, a_shape_attention, or vertical_and_slash_attention. Open upstream PRs do not touch this file.
